title: U.S. House · Ohio's 13th District
area: Northeast Ohio, including Akron, Summit County and part of Stark County.

context.text: Incumbent Emilia Sykes (D) advanced unopposed from the May 5, 2026 Democratic primary. Carey Coleman won a five-way Republican primary. Sandeep Dixit is running as an independent and declared his candidacy for the general election.

summary.text: Emilia Sykes is the Democratic incumbent seeking re-election in Ohio's 13th Congressional District, which she has represented since 2023. She previously served in the Ohio House of Representatives.

background.text: Born in Akron, Ohio; earned a bachelor's degree in psychology from Kent State University, and a juris doctor and master's degree in public health from the University of Florida.
Worked as an administrative staff advisor with the Summit County Fiscal Office and as a law clerk to the chief justice of the U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the Northern District of Georgia.

positions.summary: Supported Ohio Issue 1 (2023), the ballot measure establishing a state constitutional right to make reproductive decisions including abortion.
Her official site says she is working to expand access to Medicaid and Medicare and that healthcare is a human right.
positions.quote: She is working to lower the cost of prescription drugs, expand access to Medicaid and Medicare, and combat health disparities in our communities.

positions.summary: Her official site says she supports building clean energy infrastructure and domestic clean energy such as solar, wind, hydro, geothermal and biomass, with workforce programs for the transition.
positions.quote: Congresswoman Sykes supports policies that will save Ohioans money on their energy bills, create good-paying jobs, combat the climate crisis, and build a clean energy infrastructure that will support and bolster our economy.

positions.summary: In a Signal Akron questionnaire answer, said she voted for a War Powers Resolution directing the President to withdraw U.S. forces from the war in Iran, which she said was started without congressional authorization.
positions.quote: I voted to support a War Powers Resolution directing President Trump to withdraw our armed forces from the war in Iran, which he started without Congressional authorization,

record.text: Serves on the House Committee on Transportation and Infrastructure and the House Committee on Science, Space, and Technology, including its Research and Technology Subcommittee (2023-2024).

Supported Ohio Issue 1 (2023) establishing a state constitutional right to abortion, which voters approved, and opposed the August 2023 measure that would have raised the vote threshold to approve future constitutional amendments to 60%, which voters rejected.

summary.text: Carey Coleman is the Republican nominee for Ohio's 13th Congressional District. He has worked as a radio host on WNIR and as a television meteorologist.

background.text: Worked as a radio host on WNIR and as a television meteorologist.

summary.text: Sandeep Dixit is an independent candidate for Ohio's 13th Congressional District. He is a mechanical engineer and co-founder of a software firm who describes himself as not a career politician.

background.text: Immigrated to the United States at age 21; earned a bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering (1989) and a master's in integrated manufacturing systems engineering from North Carolina State University (1991), and an MBA from Cleveland State University while working full time.

Co-founded a software firm with his wife in 1996; is active locally as a CERT member and board member of the Mayfield Village Parks and Recreation Department, and previously served as president of a national Indian-American organization with more than 500,000 members.

priorities.text: Proposes $500 million per congressional district in vocational training investment.
Proposes a basic health-care guarantee for working people.
Proposes eliminating taxes on Social Security benefits.

positions.summary: Lists a 'basic healthcare guarantee for working people' as one of his three key campaign messages.

sources.title: Election 2026 voter guide: U.S. House, Senate, Summit County and Akron ballot

researchNotes: Coleman has not completed Ballotpedia's 2026 Candidate Connection survey and no campaign-website statement of issues was available via Ballotpedia, so his priorities and positions are omitted rather than inferred. Federal key votes and FEC finance totals for Sykes are added separately.
